title: Torsion in the homology of the Torelli group and the Birman-Craggs-Johnson homomorphism
summary: The Birman-Craggs-Johnson homomorphism is a homomorphism $σ\colon \mathcal{I}_g \to \mathbb{B}_3'$ from the Torelli group to a certain $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$-vector space of Boolean polynomials. In 1983, Johnson computed $H_1(\mathcal{I}_g)$ for $g \geq 3$ and showed, in particular, that the induced homomorphism on $H_1(\mathcal{I}_g)$ is injective when restricted to the subgroup generated by Dehn twists about separating simple closed curves.
